ai_glow_guide.description: Smart concierge engine that analyzes user space characteristics and produces a tailored recommendation.
inputs: Property Type (Luxury Villa, Penthouse/Apartment, Corporate Office, Retail/Showroom, Post-Renovation Site)
Approximate Size (Under 1,500 sq ft, 1,500-3,500 sq ft, 3,500-6,000 sq ft, 6,000+ sq ft)
Current Condition & Urgency (Routine Refinement, Deep Restorative, Emergency Turnover within 24h, Move-in/Move-out)
Key Priority Zones (Gourmet Kitchen, Spa Bathrooms, Hardwood/Marble Buffing, High Glass Panoramas, Odor Purification)
Desired Frequency (One-Time Deep Clean, Bi-Weekly Concierge, Weekly VIP Service, On-Demand Villa Rotation)
outputs: Recommended Signature Package (with match confidence score e.g. 98% Match)
Side-by-side comparison matrix with 2 alternate packages highlighting included services
Algorithmic 'Why We Recommended This' breakdown citing exact property details and frequency needs
Clear CTA button: 'Lock in Glow Quote™ for this Package' linking directly to the multi-step request with inputs pre-populated.

technical_and_accessibility_spec.framework: React 19 + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Lucide React + Sonner
technical_and_accessibility_spec.theme: Dark Luxury Primary (#0A0A0C) with Purple Glow accents, with high-contrast text compliance (APCA and WCAG AA). Strict exclusion of blue and green colors.
technical_and_accessibility_spec.testing_requirement: Every interactive and informational element MUST include a clear `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-glow-quote-cta', data-testid='ai-glow-guide-submit', data-testid='quote-step-1-next', etc.).
technical_and_accessibility_spec.contrast_assurance: Body text on dark backgrounds is at minimum #B0B0C3 or #FFFFFF (exceeds 4.5:1 ratio). All interactive hover states explicitly set both background and text color.
technical_and_accessibility_spec.components: All UI files should be written in JavaScript (.js / .jsx) with clean modular code.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never build generic SaaS designs. GARWOOD GLOW JA is an ultra-luxury Jamaican concierge brand. Give it the polish of Aman Resorts and Rolls-Royce.
Logo native placement: The provided logo is on black. The navbar, hero, and dark-themed components must seamlessly integrate this black background mark.

Strict Color Compliance: Primary Black (#0A0A0C), Secondary Royal Purple (#8B2FC9), Soft Glow Purple (#B87CF8), White text, Crisp Light Grey surfaces. Strictly NO blue (#0000FF, #1B93A4, cyan, etc.) and NO green (#00FF00, teal, etc.).
Keep typography geometric and modern: Use 'Outfit' or clean geometric sans for headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body. Never use generic 'Inter' for headings.

Include every page requested: Home, About, Services, Individual Service Detail, Before & After Gallery (with interactive slider & masonry filter), Request a Glow Quote™ (5-step form), AI Glow Guide (interactive concierge engine), FAQ, Blog, Contact, Privacy, Terms, and Admin Dashboard.
All interactive elements must carry descriptive data-testid attributes for reliable end-to-end testing.
Make the AI Glow Guide dynamic: users make selections, click 'Generate Glow Plan & Comparison', and see instant intelligent feedback explaining why the plan was chosen based on their inputs.
